row.evidence: Freshservice's own docs refer to "the Okta/Azure AD/One-login SCIM integrations" and "SCIM sync", but neither the pricing page (Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99, Enterprise Custom) nor any live Freshservice help article says which plan includes SCIM.
row.notes: Status moved from gated (June: SCIM on Pro) to unknown: SCIM integrations exist, but no first-party page found states the SCIM plan, so the June "Pro" gate is dropped. Prices unchanged: Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99 per agent/mo billed annually, Enterprise Custom. SSO (SAML/OAuth2/OIDC/JWT via Freshworks organization) is ticked on all four plans. Microsoft's Entra gallery app "Freshservice Provisioning" uses a Freshservice marketplace app "Azure Provisioning (SCIM)" and tenant URL https://scim.freshservice.com/scim/v2 (IdP page; no plan stated). Okta OIN Freshservice app is SAML only; Okta provisioning is via Aquera (third party). JumpCloud sync is a vendor-run Freshservice marketplace app. REST API v2 on all plans (100-500 calls/min by plan).

limitations.text: Requester external_id is the IdP identifier used for identity mapping during SCIM sync.

scim.notes: No first-party SCIM guide found. Microsoft's Entra provisioning tutorial (see idp_apps.entra) documents the base URL, bearer token and attribute list.

endpoints.purpose: Permanently delete an agent and their requested tickets

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Log Export API exists; the pricing page lists audit logs on Enterprise only, but the API docs do not state a plan.

rate_limits.text: Overall per minute: Starter 100, Growth 200, Pro 400, Enterprise 500; paid add-ons (Pro and Enterprise only) raise it to 1,000 or 2,000.

okta.notes: OIN Freshservice app (rendered) checks SAML only. Aquera sells a separate Freshservice Provisioning Connector (third party). Freshservice mentions an Okta SCIM integration but no guide was found.

entra.notes: Gallery app "Freshservice Provisioning": tenant URL https://scim.freshservice.com/scim/v2, long-lived bearer token from the Freshservice marketplace app "Azure Provisioning (SCIM)"; create, remove and attribute sync; attributes include userName, active, emails, displayName, name, phoneNumbers, addresses, locale, title, timezone, externalId, enterprise department/manager and freshservice isAgent.

google.notes: Freshservice is not in Google Workspace's autoprovisioning app list (the list shows Freshdesk and Front).

onelogin.notes: Freshservice mentions a OneLogin SCIM integration; OneLogin catalogue not loaded (blocks bots) and no vendor OneLogin guide found.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud catalogue guide covers SAML SSO only; user sync comes from the vendor's "JumpCloud for Freshservice" marketplace app.

fallbacks.other_sync: JumpCloud for Freshservice marketplace app (vendor-run user sync)
